note: Owner-editable ground effects (owner 2026-09-27: 'We need a visual layer to show terrain effects that show what youre doing to the ground'). An ability that leaves an area behind (Ashfall's 'The area becomes Ash Terrain') places a zone on the map for its duration; a named terrain's rules come from here. difficult: 'hostile' (only the creator's foes) or 'all'; obscured: 'light' or 'heavy' (shown on the table, applied by the GM); move_through: a save a hostile makes the first time on a turn it moves more than min_ft through the zone; color: the overlay's tint. The words 'difficult terrain', 'lightly obscured' and 'heavily obscured' in an area ability's own text apply without a named terrain. enter_start: a save a creature makes on entering the zone for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there (who: hostile or any); from_ability: that save is against the creating ability's own damage (Molten Terrain's 'the damage listed by the talent'). move_through.effects without an ability happen with no save (Shattered Glass).

walls_note: Walls (owner 2026-09-27: 'walls ... should be able to be placed and block los when applicable as well as movement'; 'We might have to flesh them out if they arent'). A wall named here rises across the line from its user through the chosen square. blocks_movement: no one walks through, and nothing is targeted through it (line of effect); see_through: that solid wall does not hide what is behind it on the table (Force Wall). obscures 'all' / 'hostile': it hides what is behind it (for everyone / for its creator's foes) and attacks through it have Disadvantage; it can be walked through. cover: attacks through it get Half Cover (+2 AC), or Three-Quarters Cover (+5 AC) where the text says so (Dune Wall, Wind Wall; Gate4ControllerEngine._cover_bonus_actor_to_actor). move_cost: movement through it costs that many times as much; difficult 'hostile': difficult terrain for its creator's foes. enter: the ability's own effects happen to a creature entering it (on/who). leaves: ground it leaves when it ends. breach: an Action beside it with a check against its creator's save DC -- 'collapse' removes that 5-foot section, 'opening' opens it until the start of the creature's next turn; min_size limits who may try. length_by_cl: [[CL, feet], ...]. PROPOSED RULINGS (the texts are silent): Glacier Wall is clear ice (see-through); Puzzle Wall's Puzzle Method is an Intelligence (Investigation) check; Lava Wall leaves Obsidian Terrain (the caster's choice of Molten is the GM's); Wall of Darkness and Monsoon give Disadvantage to attacks through them like Wall of Smoke. object: a solid wall's AC and hit points from its text -- per 5-foot section ('Each section/panel has') or for the whole wall ('The wall has'); a creature may attack a section with a weapon ("Attack a wall section", combat/ext/docket_walls.py); a destroyed section opens, a destroyed wall ends. Formulas use its creator's pb, cl and save_dc.
